translation:
(This is in the middle of the two thighs, at the two ends of the pubic bone, commonly called the thigh seam (髀縫).)
[Comment] The chest and abdomen folding method: the straight cun is made along the midline. From the middle of the supraclavicular fossa, the Tiantu point, up to the Zhongting (中庭) point at the junction of the forked bones, fold it as eight cun and four fen. From the junction of the forked bones above the chest bone down to the center of the navel, fold it as eight cun. From the center of the navel down to the pubic hairline, the Qugu (曲骨) point, fold it as five cun. The horizontal cun is made by the distance between the two nipples, folded as eight cun. The horizontal and straight cun methods of the chest and abdomen both follow this. <ins>Back (背部)</ins>
From the back bone (膂骨) down to the coccyx, twenty-one segments, it is three chi long.
